file Makefile (4355 bytes)
>| # Generated by cup — do not edit by hand.
>| #
>| # Discovery-based build: every rule below is generated from the *set of paths*
>| # found under src/, so adding an app, lib, or test never edits this file. That
>| # keeps the Makefile conflict-free on rebase — components only ever add files in
>| # their own directory.
>| #
>| #   make                 build all apps and libraries (Debug)
>| #   make MODE=Release     build optimised
>| #   make MODE=Coverage    build instrumented for coverage
>| #   make test             build and run every test in src/tests
>| #   make clean            remove the build/ tree
>| #
>| # Objects land under build/<MODE>/obj (mirroring the source tree), archives under
>| # build/<MODE>/lib, and app/test binaries under build/<MODE>/bin.
>| 
>| MODE ?= Debug
>| CXX  ?= c++
>| AR   ?= ar
>| 
>| # `all` is the default goal even though the generated per-lib/app rules below are
>| # defined first (make would otherwise take the first of those as the default).
>| .DEFAULT_GOAL := all
>| 
>| # --- per-mode flags ---------------------------------------------------------
>| CXXFLAGS_Debug    := -g -O0
>| CXXFLAGS_Release  := -O2 -DNDEBUG
>| CXXFLAGS_Coverage := -O0 -g --coverage
>| LDFLAGS_Coverage  := --coverage
>| 
>| CXXFLAGS := -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra $(CXXFLAGS_$(MODE)) $(EXTRA_CXXFLAGS)
>| LDFLAGS  := $(LDFLAGS_$(MODE)) $(EXTRA_LDFLAGS)
>| 
>| # --- output tree ------------------------------------------------------------
>| BUILD  := build/$(MODE)
>| OBJDIR := $(BUILD)/obj
>| BINDIR := $(BUILD)/bin
>| LIBDIR := $(BUILD)/lib
>| 
>| # --- optional, self-contained overrides (no shared edits required) ----------
>| # A project-wide third-party file and per-lib deps.mk files may append to
>| # CUP_TP_INCLUDES / CUP_TP_LIBS without touching this Makefile.
>| -include third_party/third_party.mk
>| -include $(wildcard src/libs/*/deps.mk)
>| 
>| # --- component discovery (the "list of paths, grouped by libs") -------------
>| # A lib is any directory under src/libs that directly holds .cpp sources; it is
>| # archived into lib<mangled-path>.a. Every directory under src/libs is an include
>| # root so header-only libs are usable too. Apps and tests are discovered the same
>| # way and link against every lib archive (the linker only pulls the objects each
>| # binary actually references out of the static archives, so unused libs are free).
>| lib_src_dirs := $(sort $(patsubst %/,%,$(dir $(shell find src/libs -name '*.cpp' 2>/dev/null))))
>| lib_inc_dirs := $(shell find src/libs -type d 2>/dev/null)
>| app_dirs     := $(shell find src/apps -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d 2>/dev/null)
>| test_srcs    := $(wildcard src/tests/*.cpp)
>| 
>| INCLUDES := $(addprefix -I,$(lib_inc_dirs)) $(CUP_TP_INCLUDES)
>| 
>| # libname: src/libs/utils/json -> utils_json ; archive: its .a under $(LIBDIR).
>| libname = $(subst /,_,$(patsubst src/libs/%,%,$(1)))
>| archive = $(LIBDIR)/lib$(call libname,$(1)).a
>| 
>| lib_archives := $(foreach d,$(lib_src_dirs),$(call archive,$(d)))
>| 
>| # --- generic compile rule (source tree mirrored under $(OBJDIR)) ------------
>| $(OBJDIR)/%.o: %.cpp
>| 	@mkdir -p $(dir $@)
>| 	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) $(INCLUDES) -c $< -o $@
>| 
>| # --- per-lib archive rules --------------------------------------------------
>| define LIB_template
>| $(call archive,$(1)): $(patsubst %.cpp,$(OBJDIR)/%.o,$(wildcard $(1)/*.cpp))
>| 	@mkdir -p $$(dir $$@)
>| 	$(AR) rcs $$@ $$^
>| endef
>| $(foreach d,$(lib_src_dirs),$(eval $(call LIB_template,$(d))))
>| 
>| # --- per-app link rules -----------------------------------------------------
>| define APP_template
>| $(BINDIR)/$(notdir $(1)): $(patsubst %.cpp,$(OBJDIR)/%.o,$(wildcard $(1)/*.cpp)) $(lib_archives)
>| 	@mkdir -p $$(dir $$@)
>| 	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) $$^ -o $$@ $(LDFLAGS) $(CUP_TP_LIBS)
>| endef
>| $(foreach d,$(app_dirs),$(eval $(call APP_template,$(d))))
>| 
>| app_bins := $(foreach d,$(app_dirs),$(BINDIR)/$(notdir $(d)))
>| 
>| # --- per-test link rules ----------------------------------------------------
>| define TEST_template
>| $(BINDIR)/$(basename $(notdir $(1))): $(OBJDIR)/$(basename $(1)).o $(lib_archives)
>| 	@mkdir -p $$(dir $$@)
>| 	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) $$^ -o $$@ $(LDFLAGS) $(CUP_TP_LIBS)
>| endef
>| $(foreach s,$(test_srcs),$(eval $(call TEST_template,$(s))))
>| 
>| test_bins := $(foreach s,$(test_srcs),$(BINDIR)/$(basename $(notdir $(s))))
>| 
>| # --- phony targets ----------------------------------------------------------
>| .PHONY: all test clean
>| all: $(app_bins) $(lib_archives)
>| 
>| test: $(test_bins)
>| 	@set -e; for t in $(test_bins); do echo "== $$t =="; ./$$t; done
>| 
>| clean:
>| 	rm -rf build
>|

>| # apt packages of registered third-party dependencies in sync; `cup docker build`
>| # versions and tags it, and `cup compiler verify` compiles the project in it.
>| #
